summary: Validated the Programs per Publisher transpose end-to-end through the public API and browser. Fresh sample generation reached ready without BSON recursion, sample/cumulative program_reports structures and exact Collegedunia values passed, all requested backend regressions passed, all three report tabs and both filter families worked in weekly and cumulative views, regression pages rendered without console errors, and the production frontend build succeeded.

issues: From/To still use browser-native input[type=date] controls instead of the available shadcn calendar/date-range component, resulting in browser-dependent picker UX.

action_items: Optional UX follow-up: replace cumulative native date inputs with the shadcn date-range picker.

Add explicit loading failure states to Dashboard, History, ReportView, Compare, and Settings initial API requests; several currently use uncaught awaits/promises and can remain loading or blank on network failure.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.load, History.load, ReportView.fetchDoc/poll, ComparePage initial requests, and Settings initial request do not catch API failures or expose retryable error states. CumulativeView now handles this correctly and can be used as the pattern.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created two TEST-filter upload reports and one fresh sample report, then deleted all test-created reports and restored global settings. The two required pre-existing ready sample reports remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: program_reports passed exact key coverage for All plus Collegedunia, Shiksha, Google Ads, Meta Ads, CollegeSearch, Organic/Direct, and Sulekha. Sample Collegedunia APPLIED was 7/9/28/44; cumulative was 14/18/56/88 and Total Leads was 12682. publisher_reports remained All/B.Com/BBA/PGDM, publisher amount All-sync passed, malformed/reversed dates returned 400, exports were valid XLSX, and only the two ready sample reports remain after cleanup. The initial browser retry failures were test assertion/wait defects (percentage expectation and History loading wait), corrected in subsequent runs; no product defect was indicated.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior BSON recursion regression is resolved by storing program_reports.All as a trimmed copy of programs/columns/matrix/summary metadata rather than embedding result itself. Current fresh sample reports persisted and reached ready, and no new processing exception appeared after the report_engine reload.
